doc_title_en: Notice regarding Change in Dividend Policy (Change in Target Payout Ratio and Introduction of Progressive Dividend) and Revision of Dividend Forecast for FY3/27
doc_title_jp: 配当方針の変更（目標配当性向の変更ならびに累進配当の導入）および2027年３月期 配当予想の修正に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 資本効率の向上と株主還元の一層の充実を図り、継続的かつ安定的な配当を実施

summary_en: Target payout ratio raised from 40% to 50%. Progressive dividend policy adopted for FY27–FY29 (no cuts, maintain or increase). FY27 annual dividend increased to ¥80/share from ¥70/share.
summary_jp: 目標配当性向 40% → 50% に引き上げ。FY27–FY29 で累進配当導入（原則減配なし）。FY27 配当予想 ¥70 → ¥80/株に増額。
tag_en: Dividend Policy – Target payout ratio 40% → 50%, progressive dividend FY27-29, FY27 dividend ¥80/share (+¥10)
tag_jp: 配当方針変更 – 目標配当性向 40% → 50%、累進配当 FY27-29、FY27 配当 ¥80/株 (+¥10)
